summary: Lincoln County, OR: 40-ft pole tower, built 1934 or 1935 (sources differ), removed or destroyed in 1950; no source found that describes the site today.

facts.design: 40-foot pole tower with a live-in cab
facts.status_note: Tower removed (firetower.org) or destroyed (firelookout.com) in 1950; no source describes the site today

events.note: Register and firelookout.com date the tower to 1935; a newspaper quoted on Rex's page reports it completed in October 1934
Firetower.org says removed; firelookout.com says destroyed

evidence.quote: This 40' pole live-in tower was built in 1935 and removed in 1950.

evidence.supports: a 2010 photograph of the site exists; caption only
evidence.quote: Hilltop Lookout site 2010 - courtesy of Howard Verschoor

evidence.supports: October 1934 newspaper: lookout house and tower completed
evidence.quote: has been completed in the last few days

evidence.supports: location on the divide between Big Elk Creek and Drift Creek
evidence.quote: on divide between Big Elk creek and Drift creek

evidence.supports: 1934 newspaper names the Siuslaw National Forest supervisor
evidence.quote: supervisor of the Siuslaw national forest

evidence.supports: site listed as removed, no date

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firetower.org and firelookout.com give 1935; a newspaper quoted on Rex's page says the tower was completed in October 1934. The event is recorded as 1935 with the 1934 report in the note, and the story gives both dates.
Firetower.org says removed in 1950; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1950. The year agrees, so the event is 1950 and the verb is reported as a disagreement.
The 1934 newspaper names the Siuslaw National Forest supervisor; the register lists Lincoln FPA. The register listing is used for the agency fact and the older wording is reported in the story.

notes_for_editor: Brief coordinates (44.53662, -123.79025) match firetower.org. The west_us_lookouts coordinates in the brief (44.5361, -123.7985) differ by about 0.008 degrees of longitude (roughly 0.6 km); I could not check that second source, so the brief's coordinates were left unchanged. Build year is disputed (1934 newspaper vs 1935 register). One web search and the three pages found nothing on the site today, so access is left out of facts. Height 12.2 m is 40 feet from the register and firelookout.com. The register's 2010 site photo is noted but not recorded as a new photo find.
